from_notes: They also introduced new clothing styles, such as turbans, tunics, trousers, and long coats. ... Caps, helmets, and boots brought by Central Asians became common among warriors.
x: The Shakas and Kushanas introduced the turban, tunic, trousers and heavy long coat, and Central Asians also brought caps, helmets and boots, so all five items are correct. The old app key (II, III, IV, V) wrongly left out the turban, which the sources list first.
evidence: R.S. Sharma, India's Ancient Past, ch. Central Asian Contacts and their Results (turban, tunic, trousers, heavy long coat; cap, helmet, boots)
dispute: The old notes said the APPSC 2024 key leaves out the turban (II–V); the official key could not be found. PMF and R.S. Sharma list the turban first among the Shaka–Kushana items, so all five are keyed.
